ios.desc:
Do? is a private, beautifully designed journal for your intimate life — a place where every moment becomes a story of time, place, and connection.

Your intimacy is more than a date on a calendar. It's a real part of your physical and emotional wellbeing, and it deserves a space that's thoughtful, elegant, and entirely your own.

A MAP OF YOUR OWN
Your places have their own tab. Every located moment gathers into a cluster on a living map — each face is someone you were with, so a whole chapter reads at a glance. Tap a cluster to browse what happened there, or zoom all the way out to a globe. Located moments even capture the weather at the time, so a memory comes back with its whole atmosphere.

START IN ONE TAP
Add the Do? complication to your Apple Watch face and begin from your wrist — fourteen looks to choose from. Or say it to Siri, find it in Spotlight, run it from Shortcuts or the Action button, or long-press the app icon. The fastest way to record is the one you never have to look for.

LIVE, ON YOUR WRIST
Watch your pulse climb in real time. Do? tracks duration, active calories, and heart-rate trends, then hands the whole picture back to your iPhone — with a live pulse curve on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while you go. Fully integrated with HealthKit and saved as an Apple Fitness workout, because intimacy is wellness too.

RELIVE EVERY DETAIL
A located record opens with the map, the weather, and the exact span of time. Heart rate is drawn as one continuous curve — drag along it to read your BPM and intensity zone at any second.

SEE YOUR RHYTHM
A heatmap, streaks, and a grid of small cards you take in at a glance — tap any one for a chart made for that data and the records behind the number. Four new things surface from records you already have, with nothing extra to fill in: the time between moments, together versus alone, what you tried for the first time this year, and the combination you rated highest. Filter Today, stats, and the map by any one partner — or by Solo.

MAKE IT ENTIRELY YOURS
Rename locations, add your own postures and protection methods, craft personal highlights — and give any of them an icon you drew yourself or cut out of a photo. Log solo moments or partner sessions, with ejaculation location and a note — photos, Live Photos, or video kept safely in one private timeline.

SHARE WITH ONE PARTNER
Privately bond your account with one partner over iCloud and let intimate moments sync to both sides. See ta's feeling

quotes.text:
Sexual health is health. We believe that understanding your intimate life is key to a happier, healthier you.

Why Choose Do?

A Beautiful Intimacy Journal
Forget boring lists. Do? offers a stunning, calendar-based diary to log your solo sessions and partner encounters. It’s designed to be as private and personal as the moments you record.

Visualize Your Passion
Sync seamlessly with HealthKit and Apple Watch. Watch your heart rate climb and see exactly how many calories you burn during intimacy. Turn your passion into tangible health data and see your "Peak Moments" and "Slow Burns."

Discover Hidden Patterns
Are you more active on weekends? Do you prefer mornings or late nights? Our GitHub-style heatmaps and detailed charts reveal the trends of your desire, helping you understand your body like never before.

Privacy First, Always
Your secrets are safe with us. Do? is built with privacy at its core. Your data stays on your device or your private iCloud. We have zero access to your personal life. FaceID/TouchID lock is supported for that extra layer of peace of mind.

Stay in the Moment
With our standalone Apple Watch app, you can start, pause, and stop recordings without ever reaching for your phone. Focus on the experience, and let us handle the tracking.

Key Features:
• Detailed Logging: Track duration, positions, locations, and protection methods.
• Partner Journal: Manage memories with different partners respectfully and organized.
